description:
Explicitly deferred. Do not implement in the V1 cutover. Does not block the parent epic.

## Items

- Multiple epic ids in one goal (`scopeIds` length > 1). The array exists in the V1 goal record so this does not require a minions protocol change later.
- Observing path overlap from minions-managed edit/write tools (still advisory).
- Linking beadwork TUI to live minion rows (V1: ask the parent or `list_minions`).
- Compose-buffer-aware turn ordering.
- Custom task-type registration by third-party adapters.

## Why deferred

V1 proves one epic, shared checkout, and packets. Each item above is a product increment, not a hole in the constitution.
